notes: Language-neutral parser spec. The Kotlin :core module will load this same file; parser-spec/run.mjs validates it today.
Regex dialect: the common subset of JavaScript and Java (named groups are camelCase alphanumeric, no lookbehind). Bodies are whitespace-normalised to single spaces before matching.
First match wins, but a body matching more than one template is a fixture failure (ambiguity).
Never invent data: a field not captured stays absent. Bodies matching nothing are UNPARSED (kept for review), never dropped.

templates.regex: ^Sent {{AMT}} from (?<bank>.+?) A/c X(?<acct>\d+) to (?<payee>.+?) on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. UPI Ref (?<ref>\d+)
^Your a/c no\. X+(?<acct>\d+) is debited for {{AMT}} on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}) and credited to a/c no\. X+(?<cpAcct>\d+) \(UPI Ref no (?<ref>\d+)\)(?: -(?<bankTag>[A-Za-z ]+))?
^Received {{AMT}} in your (?<bank>.+?) AC (?<acct>\d+) from (?<payer>.+?) on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. ?UPI Ref: ?(?<ref>\d+)
^Your a/c no\. X+(?<acct>\d+) is credited for {{AMT}} on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}) and debited from a/c no\. X+(?<cpAcct>\d+) \(UPI Ref no (?<ref>\d+)\)(?: -(?<bankTag>[A-Za-z ]+))?
^(?<bank>[A-Za-z ]+?) Bank Credit Card XX(?<acct>\d+) debited for {{AMT}} on (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}) for UPI-(?<ref>\d+)-(?<payee>.+?)\.
^Debited {{AMT}} from a/c X(?<acct>\d+) on (?<date>\d{2}[A-Za-z]{3}\d{2}) (?<time>\d{2}:\d{2}) via UPI to (?<payee>.+?)\. Ref (?<ref>\d+)\.Bal {{BAL}}\.(?:.*-(?<bankTag>[A-Za-z ]+))?$
^Savings No X+(?<acct>\d+) credited with {{AMT}} towards (?<desc>.+?) on (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{4})\.Avl Bal (?<balance>{{NUM}})
^E-Mandate! {{AMT}} will be deducted on (?<date>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2}), \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} For (?<payee>.+?) mandate UMN (?<umn>\S+)(?:.*-(?<bankTag>[A-Za-z ]+))?$

^Your A/c No\.X+(?<acct>\d+) is debited with {{AMT}} on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}) (?<time>\d{1,2}:\d{2} [AP]M) and (?<cpBankCode>[A-Z]+) A/c linked to (?<cpVpa>\S+) is credited \(UPI Ref No\.(?<ref>\d+)\)\.Current AVBL bal is {{BAL}} - (?<bankTag>[A-Za-z ]+)$
^ICICI Life policy (?<policy>\S+) is due\. Premium of {{AMT}} will be deducted on due date (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}) as per standing instructions\.
^{{AMT}} auto-debited from (?<bank>Airtel Payments Bank) a/c (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{4}) towards (?<payee>.+?) Please maintain sufficient balance
^Dear (?<bank>SBI) Cardholder, outstanding of {{AMT}}, on your credit card ending (?<acct>\d+) is due on (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2})\. Min\. Amount Due: {{MIN}}\.
^(?<bank>[A-Za-z ]+?) Bank Credit Card XX(?<acct>\d+) Statement is sent to \S+\. Total of {{AMT}} or minimum of {{MIN}} is due by (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2})\.
